layout.name: Multi Color bar chart
layout.layoutData:
<# var msg = tw.resource.toolkit.TWSYS.ChartMessages; #>


function isBidi() {
 var attrData = Packages.com.lombardisoftware.portal.utils.UserAttributesHelper.getUserAttributes();
 return Packages.com.lombardisoftware.portal.utils.BidiUtils.isBidi(attrData);
}

<# function isBidi() {
  var attrData = Packages.com.lombardisoftware.portal.utils.UserAttributesHelper.getUserAttributes();
  return Packages.com.lombardisoftware.portal.utils.BidiUtils.isBidi(attrData);
} #>

chart {
	3D : "true";
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
	backgroundPaint : "#ffffffff";
	border : "@#border8";
	header : "@#label6";
	<# if (isBidi()) { #>
    	labels[0] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.bar0.label") #>";
    	labels[1] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.bar1.label") #>";
    	labels[2] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.bar2.label") #>";
    	labels[3] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.bar3.label") #>";
    	labels[4] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.bar4.label") #>";	
	<#} else {#>
    	labels[0] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.bar1.label") #>";
    	labels[1] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.bar2.label") #>";
    	labels[2] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.bar3.label") #>";
    	labels[3] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.bar4.label") #>";
    	labels[4] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.bar5.label") #>";
    <# } #>
	name : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.name") #>";
	opaque : "true";
	preferredSize : "408,256";
	projectorReversed : "false";
	renderingType : "BAR";
	sampleSeries[0] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.dataSet1.text") #>,100,125,245.78,147,67:BAR";
	type : "CARTESIAN";
	XGridVisible : "true";
	YGridVisible : "true";
}

chart3DView {
	depth : "5";
	projectionType : "OBLIQUE";
	ZAnnotationVisible : "false";
}

chartGrid {
	majorPaint : "#ffd3d3d3";
	majorStroke : "@=stroke5";
}

chartLegend {
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="-1"] {
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	labelColor : "#ff000000";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-10";
	labelRotation : "0";
	majorTickVisible : "true";
	titleColor : "#ff000000";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="0"] {
	autoDataRange : "true";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-10";
	labelRotation : "0";
	majorTickVisible : "true";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="0"] axis {
	autoVisibleRange : "true";
}



point[index=="0"] {
	color1 : "#FF8c7db4";
}

point[index=="1"] {
	color1 : "#FF999966";
}

point[index=="2"] {
	color1 : "#FF7173b4";
}

point[index=="3"] {
	color1 : "#FF91a391";
}

point[index=="4"] {
	color1 : "#FF00566f";
}

series[index="0"] {
	renderingType : "CLUSTERED_BAR";
}

Subobject#border4 {
	bottom : "5";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "5";
	right : "5";
	top : "5";
}

Subobject#border7 {
	bottom : "5";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "5";
	right : "5";
	top : "5";
}

Subobject#border8 {
	bottom : "1";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "1";
	right : "1";
	top : "1";
}

Subobject#label3 {
	border : "@#border4";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-12";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.header") #>";
}

Subobject#label6 {
	border : "@#border7";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-12";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.MultiColorBar.header") #>";
}

Subobject#stroke5 {
	class : "java.awt.BasicStroke(lineWidth,endCap,lineJoin,miterLimit,dashArray,dashPhase)";
	dashPhase : "0.0";
	endCap : "0";
	lineJoin : "2";
	lineWidth : "1";
	miterLimit : "3.732051";
}
